meta.phase-name: Generated Registry And Dialogue Presentation Consolidation

phase-plan.purpose: Remove non-canonical runtime/editor pack concepts from the public content-pack registry, generate registry artifacts instead of hand-maintaining registry rows in `contracts/index.ts`, and move presenter/feed strings under dialogue content so narrative presentation lives with the dialogue/event lane.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: generated TS/C++/C# registry artifacts, engine build integration for registry generation, removal of `spaceVectors` and `presenterStrings` from the canonical registry, folding presenter strings into dialogue pack/schema/source data, public export cleanup, contract docs update, and verification. Out of scope: full semantic-runtime taxonomy rename away from `vectorRuntime`, docs-site Space Explorer bundle rename, and the remaining `game.ts` extraction tail.

file.description: Generates canonical registry artifacts in TS/C++/C# from contract source/data assets.
Consumes generated registry metadata and exposes canonical contract surfaces without hand-authored registry rows for internal runtime-only concepts.
Canonical merged source; dialogue pack now owns presenter/feed strings.
Dialogue/editor schema updated so presenter strings live inside dialogue pack.
Architecture reference doc updated with generated-registry and canonical-vs-internal pack conventions.
